sections.heading: Choosing the Right Screening Material for Your Leesburg Property
sections.body: Not all window and door screens are created equal, and selecting the right screening material can make a meaningful difference in comfort, durability, and energy efficiency for your Leesburg property. Standard fiberglass mesh is a popular and economical choice for most residential applications, offering reliable insect protection and reasonable airflow. For properties that receive significant sun exposure, solar screening materials can help reduce heat gain and glare while still providing ventilation. Pet-resistant screening options are available for homeowners with animals that tend to push or scratch against screens. On the commercial side, heavy-duty screening products are better suited to high-traffic areas such as lobbies, common areas, and ground-level retail spaces. Our team will walk you through the available options and help you choose the material that best fits your functional needs, budget, and aesthetic preferences. We stay up to date on the latest screening products so we can offer Leesburg clients practical, informed recommendations without overcomplicating the decision.
